string-array.item: Moving 16×16 blocks across, one at a time.
Every chunk accounted for. All of them.
Your world is crossing a version boundary.
LevelDB is having a moment. Bear with it.
Java to Bedrock is one translation away.
We do not make blocks, we just move house.
One chunk is home to 16×16×384 blocks.
The CPU is working hard. The fan knows.
If the bar is still, it is tidying the database.
Bedrock likes it quiet. Give it a minute.
Past a thousand chunks, time stops being counted in seconds.
The bigger the world, the more it is worth the wait.
Even the mobs are queuing up to move.
Your cat will recognise you in the new world.
The redstone clock starts ticking again over there.
Halfway is still a place. Keep going.
Somewhere, a chest is being unpacked.
